 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. New England Patriots running back Corey Kiner is a player to add in fantasy football in Week 10. With injuries creating uncertainty in the Patriots ' offensive backfield, Kiner might have an opportunity to earn more carries this week and become a potential waiver-wire sleeper who delivers on expectations.
 Kiner led the Patriots with eight carries for 55 rushing yards and a rushing touchdown against the Green Bay Packers last week. Rhamondre Stevenson finished with 32 rushing yards on six attempts, and given the quiet game that he had, coupled with the fact that he is battling through injuries, Kiner might benefit from an increased workload moving forward.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement TreVeyon Henderson is out for Week 10 due to an illness, while Stevenson is also battling a knee injury. With Henderson unavailable and Stevenson's health uncertain, Kiner might see additional opportunities in the Patriots' rushing attack. His potential workload makes him an intriguing speculive addition for fantasy football team managers to make.
 Kiner has recorded 50 carries for 244 yards and a touchdown. Although his production has been limited this season, the Patriots' offensive backfield situation might create an opportunity for Kiner to produce more in Week 10.
